issues.explanation: The title typography uses hardcoded values (24px, semi-bold) that do not match the 'h4' design token (28px, regular) provided in the design system. The visual reference confirms headings use this larger, regular weight style.
issues.fixedCode:
title: {
    fontSize: 28,
    fontWeight: '400',
    lineHeight: 40,
    color: '#FFFFFF',
    marginBottom: 12,
  },

screenLevelIssues.explanation: The Simulator screenshot shows a gray divider line above the 'Proceed' button which is NOT present in the Figma design. This is caused by the `showDivider={true}` prop on the PrimaryButton.

In the Simulator, the title and subtitle are visually centered (e.g., the second line of the subtitle 'verify once entered' is centered relative to the first line). In Figma, these texts are strictly left-aligned. While the style says 'left', the `alignItems: 'center'` on the parent `headerBlock` combined with potential behavior of the custom `Text` component is causing visual centering. Ensure left alignment is enforced.
screenLevelIssues.fixedCode: textAlign: 'left', // Ensure this overrides any default centering from the component or parent

screenLevelIssues.explanation: Same issue as the title: the subtitle text is rendering centered in the simulator (evident from the wrapping line), but is left-aligned in the Figma design.
